name: Isolde
subtitle: Cornish Queen
description: Motivate Cornwall to victory in battle by increase Turn Meter and Healing the Wounds of your Allies.
lore: Although betrothed to another, Isolde found herself passionately involved with Sir Tristan, thanks to a love potion they mistakenly consumed. They traveled together for years, but Isolde’s experience since the Shattering has changed her. She seeks to reverse the potion—not because she feels less for Tristan, but because she believes, if their love is real, it will survive the spell’s breaking.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.

skills.name: Queen of Cornwall
skills.description: Place [mechanic:def-up-i] on all allies for 1 turn then increases the turn meter of all allies by 10%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place [ATK Up I] on all allies for 1 turn.

skills.name: Elixir of Fate
skills.description:
Remove 1 random [Debuff] from all allies then Increase the turn meter of all allies by 15%. Increase by a further 5% if a [Debuff] is removed from the ally.

If Tristan is on the enemy team, has a 75% chance to place [mechanic:charm] on them for 2 turns which cannot be resisted.

skills.name: Heart's Echo
skills.description: When an ally Defender is attacked, Heal 10%MAXHP all allies.

skills.name: Royal Herbs
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 150%ATK. Place [mechanic:mend] on the ally with the lowest HP for 2 turns. If Tristain is on the team, he will also receive [mechanic:mend].

imprint_passive: When an ally Defender is attacked, Heal 5%MAXHP this hero.
